title: Norvale — EEOC and MDHR promotion-denial charges
forum: EEOC Minneapolis Area Office and Minnesota Department of Human Rights; parallel charge preparation

timeline.event: Employer communicated final promotion denial; client alleges race discrimination
Client found an earlier positive review
Coworker described changes to the promotion criteria
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for thirteen days after signing

documents.title: Promotion decision excerpt
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Final denial communicated two hundred seventy-three days before the client workplan was signed; that notice is the alleged discriminatory act. Client alleges race discrimination. Federal 300-day scenario assumes qualifying state/local proceedings and no earlier notice or tolling. No Minnesota tolling or special deadline is assumed; neither charge is filed.

documents.title: Review and criteria comparison
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The annual review praises assembly accuracy. The later selection memo adds an unexplained leadership threshold. The discrepancy needs investigation and is not a finding of discrimination.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 5: Counsel will deliver federal and Minnesota promotion-denial charge drafts. Delivery is due thirteen calendar days after the client workplan was signed. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of workshop charge drafts

clientFacing.status: We are checking how the promotion criteria changed before drafting charges.
nextSteps: Review the comparison of the two documents.
Identify any witness who heard the criteria discussion.
